input.description: Show help for the local notes service to learn its API.

content.content:
usage: notes.py [-h] {search,read} ...

Local, synthetic SimpleNote-style task tool; all operations are read-only.

positional arguments:
  {search,read}
    search       Find notes by title; returns every match, including archived
                 notes
    read         Read one note, including its archive status and content

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
